name: YITAMOTOR Soft Quad-Fold Truck Bed Tonneau Cover Compatible with 2004-2014 Ford F-150 F150, 5.5 ft Bed (Excl. Raptor Series)
fitment:
2004-2014 Ford F-150 (Excl. Raptor series)
NOTE:
Please measure your truck bed size or contact your dealer to confirm the correct model before ordering.
Cab size does not matter as long as you have the correct model and bed size.
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
YITAMOTOR factory brand packaging, Each cover is custom-built to ensure precise compatibility with the truck. Made from high-quality, commercial-grade vinyl that will not stretch, fade or crack.
Fitment
2004-2014 Ford F-150 (Excl. Raptor series)
NOTE:
Please measure your truck bed size or contact your dealer to confirm the correct model before ordering.
Cab size does not matter as long as you have the correct model and bed size.
Features
Compatibility: Compatible with 5.5ft bed of 2004-2014 Ford F-150 F150 (Excl. Raptor series); Custom fit for ultimate cargo protection
Upgraded Buckle System: Front safety buckle works with lightweight yet non-deformable aluminum safety wire to protect the panel from damage; Rear clamp features adhesive-coated bolt to avoid thread damage and to securely hold the cover; New spring latch structure is added to prevent accidental release and facilitate safe driving
Bolt-on Installation: No-drill installation can be completed in no time with instructions and mounting hardware included; Simply unlatch and roll the cover up to bulkhead, then fix it with strap to enjoy broader truck bed access and more versatile applications compared to tri-fold alternatives
Handle any Challenge: YITAMOTOR soft quad fold tonneau cover features performance-enhanced UV- and cold-resistant PVC cover; The tough look embellishes your truck while withstanding all weather elements for all-encompassing protection
Cargo Storage Securing: Added security for your truck bed contents, deterring theft and protecting items.
